Class EntityManagerFactoryUtils

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.orm.jpa.EntityManagerFactoryUtils
public abstract class EntityManagerFactoryUtils extends Object
Helper class featuring methods for JPA EntityManager handling, allowing for reuse of EntityManager instances within transactions. Also provides support for exception translation.

主要用于框架内部。

Since:
2.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • ENTITY_MANAGER_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER

      public static final int ENTITY_MANAGER_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER
      用于清理 JPA EntityManagers 的 TransactionSynchronization 对象的订单值。返回 `DataSourceUtils.CONNECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER` - 100，以便在（如有）JDBC 连接清理之前执行 EntityManager 清理。

      • DataSourceUtils.CONNECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER

    • findEntityManagerFactory

      public static jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory findEntityManagerFactory(ListableBeanFactory beanFactory, @Nullable String unitName) throws NoSuchBeanDefinitionException
      Find an EntityManagerFactory with the given name in the given Spring application context (represented as ListableBeanFactory).

      指定的单元名称将与配置的持久化单元进行匹配，前提是发现的 `EntityManagerFactory` 实现了 `EntityManagerFactoryInfo` 接口。如果不是，则持久化单元名称将与 Spring bean 名称进行匹配，假设 `EntityManagerFactory` bean 名称遵循该约定。

      如果未指定单元名称，此方法将通过BeanFactory.getBean(Class)搜索默认的 EntityManagerFactory。

      Parameters:
      beanFactory - 要搜索的 ListableBeanFactory
      `unitName` - 持久化单元的名称（可为 `null` 或空，此时将搜索类型为 EntityManagerFactory 的单个 Bean）
      Returns:
      EntityManagerFactory
      Throws:
      NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果上下文中不存在该 EntityManagerFactory
      See Also:
      • EntityManagerFactoryInfo.getPersistenceUnitName()

    • getTransactionalEntityManager

      public static @Nullable jakarta.persistence.EntityManager getTransactionalEntityManager(jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory emf) throws DataAccessResourceFailureException
      Obtain a JPA EntityManager from the given factory. Is aware of a corresponding EntityManager bound to the current thread, for example, when using JpaTransactionManager.

      注意：如果未找到线程绑定的 EntityManager，将返回null！

      Parameters:
      emf - 用于创建 EntityManager 的 EntityManagerFactory。
      Returns:
      EntityManager，或如果未找到则为null
      Throws:
      DataAccessResourceFailureException - 如果无法获取 EntityManager
      See Also:
      • JpaTransactionManager

      public static @Nullable jakarta.persistence.EntityManager doGetTransactionalEntityManager(jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory emf, Map<?,?> properties) throws jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException

      jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException - 如果无法创建 EntityManager
      See Also:

    • doGetTransactionalEntityManager

      public static @Nullable jakarta.persistence.EntityManager doGetTransactionalEntityManager(jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory emf, @Nullable Map<?,?> properties, boolean synchronizedWithTransaction) throws jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException
      Obtain a JPA EntityManager from the given factory. Is aware of a corresponding EntityManager bound to the current thread, for example, when using JpaTransactionManager.

      与getEntityManager相同，但抛出原始的 PersistenceException。

      Parameters:
      emf - 用于创建 EntityManager 的 EntityManagerFactory。
      properties - 要传递给 createEntityManager 调用的属性（可为 null）
      synchronizedWithTransaction - 是否根据 JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType 规则自动加入正在进行的交易。
      Returns:
      EntityManager，或如果未找到则为null
      Throws:
      jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException - 如果无法创建 EntityManager
      See Also:
      • getTransactionalEntityManager(jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory)

    • applyTransactionTimeout

      public static void applyTransactionTimeout(jakarta.persistence.Query query, jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory emf)
      Apply the current transaction timeout, if any, to the given JPA Query object.

      此方法相应地设置 JPA 查询提示"jakarta.persistence.query.timeout"。

      Parameters:
      query - JPA 查询对象
      emf - 创建该查询的 JPA EntityManagerFactory

    • convertJpaAccessExceptionIfPossible

      public static @Nullable DataAccessException convertJpaAccessExceptionIfPossible(RuntimeException ex)
      Convert the given runtime exception to an appropriate exception from the org.springframework.dao hierarchy. Return null if no translation is appropriate: any other exception may have resulted from user code, and should not be translated.

      最重要的情况，如对象未找到或乐观锁失败，在此处涵盖。对于更细粒度的转换，JpaTransactionManager 等通过 JpaDialect 支持复杂的异常翻译。

      Parameters:
      ex - 运行时异常
      Returns:
      对应的 DataAccessException 实例，或者如果不应转换该异常则为null。
